text: Disaster recovery and backup strategies — two real numbers, not a vague promise that backups exist.
RPO answers how much data loss is acceptable. RTO answers how long recovery is allowed to take. Both force a real conversation about cost versus risk.
Item definitions are already covered by git integration. Delta's time travel covers table history. What's genuinely still open is the streaming data itself, beyond its own retention window.

An incident is something wrong within a system that's still there — mitigate, then fix. A genuine disaster is the system itself being gone — that calls for restoring from what was actually, deliberately backed up.
Two different problems, two different responses. Next up: data governance in production — who's allowed to touch what, and why.
